evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce PhysCount, a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish what appears in an image from what physically exists in the scene.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: PhysCount contains 546 real-world images and 4,595 human-written questions organized into 651 target-specific groups.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We measure both accuracy on each family and the proportion of groups answered entirely correctly.
